name: 廖以勒
objective:
本課程以訓練學生對陶瓷材料性質認識，並進而介紹陶瓷材料基本製程。課程重點在陶瓷粉体製備成形方法，燒結及燒結理論，除加強學生認識傳統陶瓷外，並對結構陶瓷與電子陶瓷之應用，作有系統的介紹。
This course aims at training the knowledge of ceramics materials and to introduce
the basic manufacturing process of ceramics materials.The focus of this course is
the formation method of ceramics powder, sintering and sintering theory. Except
for strengthening the perception of traditonal ceramics, it also has a systematic
introduction to the application of structural ceramics and electronic ceramics..
schedule:
1. Outline and Chemical Elements
2. Minerals and Ceramic Raw Materials
3. Chemical Bonding in Ceramic Materials, Electronegativity
4. Hardness, Melting Points and Boiling Points, and Structure
5. Crystal Systems
6. Theoretical Density
7. Miller Indices and Zone Axes
8. Morphology and Crystal Growth
9. Mechanical Properties: Cleavage and Slip
10. Surface Properties: Wetting and Etching
11. Symmetry Elements and Point Groups
12. Neumann’s Law and Tensor Properties
13. Bond Lengths and Atomic Radii
14. Ionic Radii: Trends and Regularities
15. Pauling’s Rules for Ionic Structures
16. Prediction of Structures for Crystals and Glasses
17. Zachariasen’s Rules and Structure of Glass
18. Clays and Other Layer Silicates
19. Phase Diagrams and Crystal Chemistry
20. Types of Solid Solutions
21. Phase Transformations and Structure
22. Structure Changes with Temperature and Pressure
23. Thermal Expansion and Structure
24. Specific Heat, Thermal Conductivity, and Structure
materials:
1. Introduction to Ceramics, 2nd Ed., 1976, W. D. Kingery, H. K. Bowen, and D. R. Uhlmann.
2. 晶體之結構與性質，1989。余樹楨。
